navy-body-fat.title: Foulis et al. 2023 original military body composition validation study
navy-body-fat.supports: Methods gives both sex-specific circumference equations, with centimeter-to-inch conversion. Not current Army one-site equation.

deurenberg.title: Deurenberg et al. 1991 original body fat prediction study
deurenberg.supports: Abstract explicitly gives adult and child BMI-based equations. Estimates have substantial individual error.

haycock.title: Haycock, Schwartz, Wisotsky1978 original BSA study

bsa-comparison.title: Kuehnapfel et al.2017 original 3D BSA validation study
bsa-comparison.supports: Table1 prints DuBois0.007184*kg^.425*cm^.725; primary validation of empirical equations.

pregnancy-weight-iom.title: IOM2009 Weight Gain During Pregnancy Table7-3
pregnancy-weight-iom.supports: Primary guideline gives roundedkg andlb recommendations separately, plus trimester-specific gain rates.
